sourceComparison.result: All six renderer/dispatcher blobs are identical to source pin b10c424a6b318879fc30f11d03ba1cfeffda7d1a; no known source drift deferred.

sourceDriftPolicy: Six source blobs were compared by GitHub MCP at faa30fddb7e7b61696b66fd069f51cf18c51125f and are identical to the pinned source. I00 only checks subsequent delta in dispatch candidate C. Any new source or public-contract drift requires a new documented release before affected UI dispatch; workers do not select newer source.
routeResolution: I00 owns the router assembly. Static routes before parameter routes; every entity reference segment uses routeRefCodec. All require authorized owner resolution. No default lookup on another server.

routeRefCodec.decode: Require r_ prefix, canonical base64url, valid UTF8 and exact encode(decode(value)) equality. Send original decoded ref byte-for-byte to the domain. Invalid values show invalid-link state.
routeRefCodec.scope: All path :parameters representing domain refs, including viewId, manifestId and selectionRef. Context query identifiers use URLSearchParams encoding; codec is not encryption or authorization.
